name: SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences
positioning: High-rise SLS hotel in a 75-story Dubai tower, with a 71st-floor Sky Lobby, rooftop infinity pools facing the Burj Khalifa and interiors by Paul Bishop
best_for: Travelers who want Burj Khalifa and city views from a balcony or terrace
Guests who want restaurants, a speakeasy and a rooftop pool scene under one roof

facts.text: The hotel's Sky Lobby is on the 71st floor.
Guests enter under a stained-glass window that reads 'Fortune Favours the Bold'.
Ciel Spa is on the 69th floor.
The guest room interiors are by designer Paul Bishop.
Sky King rooms have rose-gold detailing by architects Aedas and Paul Bishop.
Each room has a terrace or a balcony.
Room views take in Dubai Creek, the Burj Khalifa district or the wider city.
The Presidential Suite is a two-story suite with a double-height living room facing the Burj Khalifa.
EllaMia is a cafe with Los Angeles inspired coffee culture.
S Bar is a bar in the Sky Lobby.

highlights.text: Two infinity pools atop the 75-story tower look out to the Burj Khalifa.
Carna is a contemporary steakhouse led by butcher Dario Cecchini.
Smoke & Mirrors is a speakeasy and cigar lounge.
Signature King rooms with Burj Khalifa view have a private balcony and a soaking tub.

considerations.text: A security deposit of AED 300 is required per stay.
Privilege, the rooftop pool venue, is also a nightclub.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional resort tranquility.
